id: title:DanielVisca:decode attribute values in drop and metric rule matching

observations.behavior: Replaces direct attribute access with a decoding helper before returning values used in metric tallies and group-by labels.
observations.posthog_connection: Without this, JSON-encoded string attributes stored as quoted strings would not match filter rules or contribute to numeric sums; the Logs UI shows decoded values while ingestion uses encoded ones.

observations.behavior: Updates service name lookup and other property filters to use the shared decoder for resource and regular attributes.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures drop-rule matching and HogQL lookups compare against the same decoded representation that users see in the Logs preview and ClickHouse sink.

observations.behavior: Removes duplicate local implementation of the decoder and encoder, importing them instead. No longer redefines decode/encode locally but relies on the shared utility.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a single source of truth for wire-to-memory decoding across transformations, metrics, and sampling, preventing silent mismatches between ingestion and query paths.

observations.limitations: Only P1 chunk provided; no tests executed, no runtime behavior observed. Tier assignment depends entirely on static inspection without execution results.

review.limitations: Only P1 chunk provided; no tests executed, no runtime behavior observed. Tier assignment depends entirely on static inspection without execution results.
review.reason: Adds a consistent decoding layer for attribute values used by metric tallies, group-by labels, and filtering. This is substantive and bounded: it fixes correctness and compatibility rather than expanding capability or reducing systemic risk. Tests support this, but tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration not shown here.
review.posthog_relevance: Fixes potential rule failures and incorrect numeric aggregation when string attributes are stored as JSON-encoded strings, aligning ingestion with what users expect from the Logs UI.
review.uncertainty: Assessment based solely on code changes; actual benefit realized only after deployment and test coverage.
